measurement_note: Size is both n, the array length, and half the number of update queries. Starting from all zero bits, each round flips the full range and then adds one per active bit; for even n, exactly n / 2 rounds see n ones, so the final reported sum is n^2 / 2. A direct implementation touches all n positions for every flip and recounts them for every add, while the lazy tree updates its root state without scanning the range.
